text: Due dates on checklist items: optional, passive, a small muted date on the row that turns red when past (both clients + server)

All three parts on main (1f0c6013), full gate green: server field due (YYYY-MM-DD, migration 11, field-level LWW, invalid_field on a bad date); web dialog field + row date; Android schema 12 + dialog + row. Android models an absent 'due' as unchanged (not a zero clock) so an older server never keeps a dated item dirty; the row name is one line with an ellipsis on both clients; Duplicate copies the date. Strings identical on both clients in nine locales. Tests: pytest 960->988, web 658->670, app 834->854, core 119->121.
